name: VS Code: Projects
description: Open your VSCode: projects from anywhere using Ulauncher

preferences.name: Config path
preferences.description: The path to VSCode:'s config folder (e.g., update if you are using Code: - OSS)

preferences.name: Shared storage path
preferences.description: The path to VS Code's shared folder for the entries to the "Recent Workspaces" menu (update if you are using a different fork of VS Code)

preferences.name: Projects File path
preferences.description: The location of projects file cache created by Project Manager VSCode: Extension

preferences.name: VS Code: executable path
preferences.description: The path to the VS Code: executable

preferences.name: Include recent workspaces
preferences.description: "All" reads every workspace ever opened from the per-window workspaceStorage folder, "From Recent Workspaces Menu" reads only the shared state.vscdb entries, "False" excludes recent workspaces entirely

preferences.name: Include files
preferences.description: Include recently opened individual files (only available when reading from the Recent Workspaces menu)

preferences.name: Include project manager projects
preferences.description: Include projects from the Project Manager extension (disabled by default)
